Is The Marionette.note: The nearest good player each side of the Demon, skipping evil players, who was dealt a good character token; placing it makes them evil. A player who may register as the Demon (the Recluse) counts as the Demon.

reminders.label: Is The Marionette
reminders.text: Put [Is The Marionette] on the Marionette, a neighbour of the Demon; choose a good character they think they are
reminders.reason: The Marionette thinks they are good; this marks who really is the Marionette
